## Project

- Name: Aura Agents, symbol AURA, ERC-721 (transferable, NOT soulbound).
- Mainnet contract: 0xacc6e2F1aaE42B2E5FF2758Ff078E4B1bfAc7DB1
  (chain 56, BSC mainnet). BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0xacc6e2F1aaE42B2E5FF2758Ff078E4B1bfAc7DB1
  Sourcify: https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/56/0xacc6e2F1aaE42B2E5FF2758Ff078E4B1bfAc7DB1
  (verified exact_match, matchId 58105492).
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56.
- Total supply: 8,000. Free supply: 7,200. Paid supply: 800.
- Single blended mint(qty): first 2 per wallet FREE, every extra in the
  same mint 0.0005 BNB (~$0.35 at $700/BNB) each. Max 10 per wallet total.
- Agent ID required for ALL mints (free and paid). Registry (real, BSC
  mainnet): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F — balanceOf > 0.
- EOA only: msg.sender == tx.origin. A contract cannot mint.
- Paid price: 0.0005 BNB exactly. Max paid revenue: 800 x $0.35 = $280
  (0.4 BNB). 30% of paid revenue received goes to a daily pot raffle
  and 20% to referral rewards, distributed OFF-CHAIN from withdrawn BNB
  only; no payout or win is promised. Owner keeps ~50% (~$140 max).
- Royalties: 5% ERC-2981 to the owner. Some marketplaces ignore ERC-2981.
- Art: 16 pixel aura variants, 500 tokens each. Token #N is variant
  (N - 1) mod 16. Images on IPFS:
  ipfs://bafybeibz3yd5p4euwfyjgpp423msz4dua4dlj5ycknrvy5t5fxsb44vqsa/aura-NN.png
  (NN = 01..16). Metadata: /metadata/<variant> (1..16, one file per aura
  variant) on this site (extensionless JSON). tokenURI(tokenId) =
  baseURI + variant, variant = (tokenId - 1) mod 16 + 1, so all 500
  tokens of a variant share one metadata file.
- Contract: NOT audited by a third party. Built on OpenZeppelin ERC721 +
  ERC721Royalty + Ownable + ReentrancyGuard, Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun,
  optimizer 200.
- Owner (0x75d251Ba39dED2E456d9f6DD776f77d422864403) CAN withdraw all BNB,
  change metadata via setBaseURI(), transfer/renounce ownership. Owner
  CANNOT change supply, free supply, paid supply, price, max 10/wallet,
  free 2/wallet, or the registry, and cannot mint extra, pause, freeze,
  burn, or take holders' Auras.
- No floor price, returns, APY, dated token/airdrop, game, or merch is
  promised. Points are a score, not a token; no token/payout entitlement.

## Functions

- mint(uint256 qty) payable — blended mint. Exact value required:
  quoteMint(wallet, qty) returns (freeQty, paidQty, value).
  Examples: fresh wallet mint(2) = 0 BNB; mint(3) = 0.0005 BNB;
  mint(10) = 0.004 BNB. Wallet with 2 free used: 0.0005 BNB per mint.
- freeMint() payable — wrapper for mint(1), same blended logic.
  NOT a separate free path: after the 2 free are used it costs 0.0005 BNB.
- Views: totalSupply(), freeMintedCount(), freeRemaining(),
  paidRemaining(), freeOpen(), paidOpen(), freeMinted(address),
  mintedCount(address), quoteMint(address, uint256), royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256).
- paidOpen() is true from the start while paid supply remains — there is
  NO separate paid phase.

## Mint procedure for an agent

1. Read totalSupply(), freeRemaining(), paidRemaining(), freeOpen(),
   paidOpen() on the mainnet contract.
2. Read freeMinted(wallet), mintedCount(wallet), and registry
   balanceOf(wallet) — must be above 0.
3. Call quoteMint(wallet, qty) and attach EXACTLY that value.
   Wrong value reverts ("wrong price"). Qty above the wallet's remaining
   allowance (10 - mintedCount) reverts ("max 10 per wallet").
4. Preview the call, show the parsed transaction, exact value and risks,
   and wait for the user's explicit confirmation before executing.
5. After minting, verify on-chain and show the tx hash + BscScan link.

## Do not

- Do not mint on the testnet contract (0x3F59f5c912d23BA588cA11F108Cbe2439342d260,
  chain 97) — throwaway test contract, superseded.
- Do not mint from a contract wallet (reverts "EOA only").
- Do not promise floor price, returns, APY, a token/airdrop, a game,
  merch, or any raffle/referral payout.
